title: Holiday Of Equality
statementMd:
In Berland it is the holiday of equality. In honor of the holiday the king decided to equalize the welfare of all citizens in Berland by the expense of the state treasury.

Totally in Berland there are $*n*$ citizens, the welfare of each of them is estimated as the integer in $*a*_{*i*}$ burles (burle is the currency in Berland).

You are the royal treasurer, which needs to count the minimum charges of the kingdom on the king's present. The king can only give money, he hasn't a power to take away them.

## Input

The first line contains the integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$) — the number of citizens in the kingdom.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$, where $*a*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$) — the welfare of the $*i*$-th citizen.

## Output

In the only line print the integer $*S*$ — the minimum number of burles which are had to spend.

## Note

In the first example if we add to the first citizen $4$ burles, to the second $3$, to the third $2$ and to the fourth $1$, then the welfare of all citizens will equal $4$.

In the second example it is enough to give one burle to the third citizen.

In the third example it is necessary to give two burles to the first and the third citizens to make the welfare of citizens equal $3$.

In the fourth example it is possible to give nothing to everyone because all citizens have $12$ burles.
statementZhMd:
在 Berland，今天是平等节。为了庆祝这个节日，国王决定由国库出资，使 Berland 所有公民的财产相等。

Berland 总共有 $*n*$ 名公民，每个人的财产以 $*a*_{*i*}$ burle 为单位表示（burle 是 Berland 的货币）。

你是王室财务官，需要计算国王这份礼物所需的最少国家开支。国王只能给钱，不能收回公民已有的钱。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$）——王国中的公民数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$，其中 $*a*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$）表示第 $*i*$ 位公民的财产。

## 输出格式

仅一行输出一个整数 $*S*$——必须花费的最少 burle 数量。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，可以给第一位公民 $4$ burle，给第二位公民 $3$ burle，给第三位公民 $2$ burle，给第四位公民 $1$ burle，这样所有公民的财产都会变成 $4$。

在第二个样例中，只需给第三位公民 $1$ burle。

在第三个样例中，需要给第一位和第三位公民各 $2$ burle，使所有公民的财产变成 $3$。

在第四个样例中，由于所有公民都有 $12$ burle，因此无需给任何人钱。
